question: On which sides are Viṣṇu and the Grandfather positioned?
premises: Viṣṇu is on the right side.
The Grandfather is on the left side.
inference: Viṣṇu occupies the right side and the Grandfather occupies the left side.
plain_english: Viṣṇu is on the right side, and the Grandfather is on the left side.
